title: NABLA: A Noise-Adaptive Blockwise Left-Right Preconditioning Algorithm for Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.32781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose NABLA, a noise-adaptive blockwise left-right preconditioning algorithm for mini-batch stochastic nonconvex optimization. NABLA combines an exponential moving average of stochastic gradients with block-diagonal row and column preconditioners constructed from matrix-valued second-moment statistics. Unlike conventional matrix-preconditioned methods that use fixed decay parameters, NABLA adjusts the second-moment averaging coefficient through a closed-loop feedback rule determined by the cumulative stochastic-gradient energy and its running average. The first-moment coefficient remains fixed, allowing the trajectory-dependent adaptation to act directly on the structured preconditioners. The resulting method is horizon-free, requires no prior knowledge of the noise level, and automatically adjusts the memory of its second-moment estimators to the observed optimization dynamics. Under standard lower boundedness, smoothness, unbias

translated_title: NABLA：一种用于随机优化的噪声自适应分块左右预条件算法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了NABLA，一种用于小批量随机非凸优化的噪声自适应分块左右预条件算法。NABLA将随机梯度的指数移动平均与由矩阵值二阶矩统计量构建的分块对角行和列预条件子相结合。与使用固定衰减参数的传统矩阵预条件方法不同，NABLA通过一个由累积随机梯度能量及其滑动平均值所确定的闭环反馈规则来调整二阶矩平均系数。一阶矩系数保持固定，从而使依赖轨迹的自适应机制能够直接作用于结构化预条件子。由此得到的方法不受时间尺度限制，无需对噪声水平的先验知识，并能根据观察到的优化动态自动调整其二阶矩估计器的记忆长度。在标准的有下界性、平滑性、无偏性（假设条件下，原文至此被截断）
tldr: 本文提出NABLA算法，通过闭环反馈规则自适应调整二阶矩平均系数，实现无需噪声先验知识的分块左右预条件随机优化。
en_tdlr: NABLA is a noise-adaptive blockwise left-right preconditioning algorithm that adjusts its second-moment averaging coefficient via a closed-loop feedback rule, requiring no prior knowledge of the noise level in stochastic optimization.
